facts.fact: 吞日前夜：Nikolas 与名字同命（Nikshä=恒星、Third Sun 尾随）——「Now it only existed in remnants of plasma...Its wreckage splayed over his chest and veined over his lungs.」——「How fitting that he and his namesake would share a fate.」
神的谈判：POOR NIKOLAS/WHY FIGHT——「YOU ALREADY HAVE YOUR BROTHER. YOUR WINGS. YOUR LIBERATION FROM YOUR FATHER. WILL YOU NOT BE SATISFIED UNTIL YOU ACHIEVE MY DOWNFALL?」「TOGETHER, WE CAN MAKE THEM SORRY.」
facts.anchor: WHY DO YOU FIGHT SO HARD, NIKOLAS?

facts.fact: 自我定调：母（自痛）与父（伤人）两镜自照——「He needed to be Nikshä. He needed to be Merciful Nikai, ruins and all.」
避雷针战法：神光线被矛刃引诱、灌满 lethal radiance——Nikolas 以盾分割反轰——「Like a lightning strike to metal, the ray that burst out of Phos’s weapons was lured by the spear’s blade.」
控诉顶点：YOU IGNORED ME. YOU ABANDONED ME. YOU ABUSED ME. US——「I WAS OBEDIENT! I WAS FAITHFUL! AND IT WASN'T ENOUGH!」「WHAT WAS THE REASON FOR MY PAIN?」——信仰的真相（晨祷/操练/冷言烫手）。
facts.anchor: WHAT WAS THE REASON FOR MY PAIN?

facts.fact: 吞日决意：「You will—」断句反转——「If his pain had no meaning, he would give it one. He would reforge it into something new.」——三连名 Nikolas, Nikshä, Nikai。
facts.anchor: If his pain had no meaning, he would give it one.

facts.fact: 吞日执行：残日凝成 minor star——「If he could swallow the sun and spare his brother, he would scorch himself in the consumption and call it vital.」——Slaying the few to spare the same 的 ire 对照 Taesia。
俯冲贯喉：Nikai 如猛禽俯冲——矛穿幻影之喉入胸——「A prayer’s reply.」
